brief:
Michigan's senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed faced attacks from opponents who characterized his defence of Palestinians as motivated by hatred, according to Middle East Eye. The criticism targeted El-Sayed's position on US funding for Israel's military operations in Gaza, reframing policy disagreement as personal animus rather than engaging substantively with his stated arguments.

El-Sayed's opponents focused on attacking his motives rather than debating the underlying questions about American aid to Israel, the outlet reported. The senator-elect had advocated against continued US military funding linked to operations in Gaza.

title: Critics smeared El-Sayed's Palestinian defence as hate, Middle East Eye reports
